meta.note: Historical backtest over verified match results. Odds are MODELED unless explicitly labeled VERIFIED from free public prediction markets. See historical_odds.json for real market receipts. All results link to HLTV/Liquipedia sources for manual review.

odds_policy.description: VRS-gap fair probability + deterministic market inefficiency + 4% overround
odds_policy.formula: fair_fav = min(0.85, 0.50 + 0.025 * rank_gap); fair_dog = 1 - fair_fav; market_noise = deterministic hash-based offset [-0.08, +0.08] applied to favorite fair; then market_probs = [fair+noise] * 1.04 overround; decimal_odds = 1 / market_prob
odds_policy.vrs_ranks_source: ML-008 (Sep 16 reveal): Legacy #3, Falcons #4, FURIA #8, BETBOOM #9, 9z #10, Aurora #12, PARIVISION #17, VP #30
odds_policy.label: MODELED — not a real betting line

analytics.note: Backtest uses MODELED odds where no real free public line exists. Real market coverage is documented in historical_odds.json. No real money, no guaranteed fills, fees/slippage not modeled beyond 4% overround.

strategies.description: Backs the higher-ranked side (by Sep 16 Global VRS snapshot) in every Finals match at the best verified price available, flat 25 units per bet.
Bets only when the market price implies a win chance at least 8 points below a VRS-gap heuristic: favorite fair = 50% + 2.5% per VRS-rank gap (capped 85%). Stakes 20 units.

Outright-only paper strategy: if BOTH teams have fresh first-party best asks with enough top-of-book size in the same pre-Finals collection run, records 50 simulated units on FURIA and Falcons. Gross P/L; no real execution, fees or slippage modeled.
Control account: never bets. Exists to prove the leaderboard math (stays at 1000.00) and to benchmark activity vs inactivity.
Bets underdogs only when their decimal odds are >= 3.00 (implied <= 33.3%), 10 units flat. Skips short-priced dogs.
Fades Virtus.pro (the qualifier seed, VRS #30) in every VP group match: backs VP's opponent, 20 units flat.
Targets variance from the 7-map pool: backs underdogs ONLY in group-stage openers (unpredictable vetoes), 12 units flat. Skips playoffs.
Backs the lower-ranked side (by Sep 16 Global VRS snapshot) in every Finals match, flat 15 units per bet. Profits if underdogs overperform.
